title: Build a modular TanStack PDF workbench around existing specimens and evidence
statement: Achim requested a modular TanStack Start workbench with a clean modern Cisco-inspired shell. This blueprint maps the supplied research and PR #26 to existing PDF Lab code, preserving the creative experiment plan and defining phases 0–7 plus a bounded Claude Batch A for encounter and inspection. Documentation only; no worker launched.
conditions: Detailed technical contracts remain proposed; the current user request supplies the product/visual direction.
Hosted knowledge and snapshot were inaccessible; their current commit/completeness/diagnostics are unknown. Historical packet cutoff is older than inspected main.
PR #26 remains open at 9594563174ea856a551b95836182cd16d1531766; PR #23 narrative remains open at 283a85a602b4f7d562ee6c8bc9f417886de8ff42.
Source inspection only. No engine tests, application implementation, remote worker launch or deployment performed.
The two repeated supplied reports were condensed with attribution; not archived verbatim. Only TanStack overview and Cisco inventory references were independently read in this pass.
